# Third-party notices

## Unlock Music CLI

This directory contains a verbatim copy of the MIT license and two binary
scramble tables from the Unlock Music CLI project. The Python implementations
in `src/legacy_decoders.py` are bounded transliterations of the same project's
Go algorithms.

- Original project: Unlock Music
- Pinned source: <https://github.com/leafxdd/unlock-music/tree/aec0d85fd9f258a513ecc930a72eaf85af9e1781>
- Commit: `aec0d85fd9f258a513ecc930a72eaf85af9e1781`
- License: MIT
- Copyright: Copyright (c) 2020-2021 Unlock Music

The full license text is retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE). Per-file SHA-256
values and the exact role of every referenced source file are in
[SOURCE.json](SOURCE.json). The Python adaptation needs no Go runtime and does
not edit upstream Go files; KGM/KGG crypto v5 is intentionally unsupported and
reported as waiting.

Bundled data files:

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `tables/x2m_scramble_table.bin` | `f47bc3ea94f109650f9753329b4faa62b77eab1d37df738413c819b344838605` |
| `tables/x3m_scramble_table.bin` | `5cd0abe24ad9b04b31262f552605b62c78549f8c4aef3bf54e6c780d7e3de39e` |

No audio samples, songs, client binaries, MMKV files, real per-song keys, or machine
identifiers are included. Upstream QMC testdata is not bundled; tests read it
from the sibling read-only `upstream/` snapshot when available.

Checked-in QMC test vectors contain only synthetic test key bytes and generated byte patterns, never user song keys or audio.
